profile_text.body:
JERA Co., Inc. is a for-profit power generation company headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, with its website at jera.co.jp/en. The company describes itself as Japan's largest power generation company and says it operates the entire supply chain, from fuel upstream and procurement through to power generation.

The site also describes a Green Transformation project for Akita's food industry, launched by JERA, JERA Cross and Japan Pack Rice Oga. The renewable electricity supply is described as the first step in decarbonizing packaged rice production.
